key_findings: PARP12 mRNA knockdown in BV2 cells (without protein loss) correlated with 276 DEGs, suppressed NF-κB/TNF/chemokine inflammatory programs, and 287 alternative splicing events.
Changes cannot be attributed to PARP12 protein loss because Western blot showed no protein knockdown.
